name: infantry-reserve
_doc: Reserve (예비군, Korean faction, not legacy) rifleman: infantry-japanese design (same body, poses, bolt rifle, pack, Type 45 cap) in very dark navy (material navy_old) with thin red piping (piping_red, fixed colour, not team): collar top edge, front placket, cuffs, trouser outer seam, cap crown edge + band edges. Team colour stays on the cap band and the upper-arm patch.
